entityDescription:
Aquila Bioscience (ABL, www.aquilabioscience.com) is a life sciences company dedicated to developing innovative, effective, and technologically advanced products inspired by nature to protect people from natural and man-made biothreats, including COVID-19, H1N1, and Anthrax. Founded by a world-leading expert in carbohydrate biology (glycoscience), ABL leverages its core expertise in exploiting carbohydrate-protein interactions—essential for pathogens to bind to surfaces and hosts—to develop cutting-edge Pathogen Capture Technology (PCT) for decontamination. Committed to sustainability, ABL focuses on creating environmentally friendly solutions that are both effective and sustainable.
ABL secured support from the European Defence Agency and the European Union’s H2020 programs to develop the decontamination technology aimed at combating biothreats and infectious agents. With proven efficacy against Category A pathogens and viruses, Aquila Bioscience’s protein-carbohydrate based PCT was also awarded a European Innovation Council Accelerator Grant to scale up the commercial production of ABwipeTM, addressing the market's need for safer and more effective decontamination products during COVID-19 pandemic, saving countless lives and significant economic resources.

entityName: University of Zagreb Faculty of Geodesy - Chair of Geoinformation
entityDescription:
The Chair of Geoinformation is part of the Institute of Cartography and Photogrammetry at the University of Zagreb Faculty of Geodesy, which was established in 2005 through the merger of two historic institutes: the Institute of Photogrammetry (founded in 1941) and the Institute of Cartography (founded in 1956). The Institute is comprised of three chairs: Chair of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, Chair of Geoinformation and Chair of Cartography.

The Chair of Geoinformation focuses on teaching courses related to the handling and management of geoinformation, with a particular emphasis on cartography and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). In 2013, the Chair established Croatia’s first Open Source Geospatial Lab (OSGL), which is part of the global GeoForAll network. The lab's mission is to connect academia, industry, and public administration in the use and development of open-source geoinformation systems and data.

In addition to its educational activities, the Chair conducts scientific research in areas such as open data, service-oriented cartography, and GIS.

entityDescription: Bulduri Technical School(former "Bulduri Horticultural High School") is located on the territory of the ancient Bilderliņi crown manor on the banks of Lielupe, Bulduri, Jūrmala, near the sea. Since 1910, future specialists in the field of horticulture and horticulture have been educated in this place. Today, the training of young specialists in landscape gardening and construction, floristry, tourism, hospitality and catering industries is equally taking place! Here is the small ideal Latvia, where the truly Latvian - functional, aesthetic and durable gene is born. However, Bulduru Technical University is not only an educational institution, but at the same time it is also a company where various innovative business ideas are implemented. Young people have the opportunity to be with the introduction of the latest technologies, gain unique experience and become sought-after specialists or brave young entrepreneurs. In the territory of the technical school, there are modernly equipped greenhouses with an area of ​​2400 m2, as well as a practical training area - fields and beds with an area of ​​23 ha. The technical department has materials at its disposal - technical base and garden equipment. Advantages of training in Bulduri - theory is learned in practical work in the school's learning park, garden and greenhouse. Modern garden equipment and one of the most modern greenhouses in Latvia are available. The technical school hasa plant biotechnology laboratory, where horticulture students study and school students do practical work. An opportunity to develop the Student's Scientific Research Work. Research is also carried out in the molecular biology laboratory. Agrochemical laboratories are also under construction. Our technical school is the only vocational education institution in Latvia, which has a laboratory of this type, in which school students undergo training. A unique project has been created at the Technical University - the onlysmart garden in Latvia"Latvijas i-Dārzs". The goal of the project was to make a robot that moves between the plant beds, photographs and scans the plants with different cameras to follow the development of the plants. The control functions of the robot operate the watering system, determine the appearance of diseases and pests in time, and collect information in the database.

entityDescription:
1/About Amnovis

Amnovis is an additive manufacturing production and engineering companythat's built on no-nonsense entrepreneurship.
At Amnovis, we believe the full potential of additive manufacturing can be unlocked through thoughtful innovations, which we intend to enable for the utilization in regulated and high-tech industries.To achieve our purpose, we strive to be the catalyst of the innovation process, continuously looking for technical challenges and opportunities to redefine the state-of-the-art in AM.

2/Technologies
Bespoke 3D printing in metal and plastic

Titanium 3D printingfor demanding industries
We are innovating various titanium 3D printing applications across a broad spectrum of medical device types. As innovators of AM technology, material and applications, we are able to manufacture faster with higher quality, both standard and personalized implants.

Copper 3D printing ofstrong, conductive components
The past years, we researched and engineered the manufacturing of highly conductive copper components using the L-PFB process. We use proprietary material and process expertise to manufacture copper components with state-of-the-art electrical, thermal and mechanical properties.

Stereolithographyfor medical purposes
Our expertise in medical device 3D printing and strong focus on quality systems make us a preferred manufacturer of plastic components in medical markets and other highly regulated industries.
3/ Services

Contract manufacturing
as it should be
As a primary focus, Amnovis performs contract manufacturing of high-end parts manufacturing for quality-critical applications in medical, high-tech and other industries. Manufacturing projects range from one-off custom products up to high-volume production.
Increased product performance throughAM engineering
Our engineering services target customers who envision breakthrough products. The specialist of Amnovis co-engineer AM products by working closely with customers to take advantage of the full potential of AM. This effort may be focused on a one-off custom product or may lead to high-volume production. We are able to increase product performance through our innovation-driven approach focused on process, technology, material and quality.
Research and development that shapes the future of AM
As part of our drive for innovation, Amnovis is actively involved in multiple R&D programs. These cover internal projects, as well as projects in collaboration with external organizations. We also engage in R&D projects with customers to shape and boost their product innovation roadmap.

description:
Custom designed and advanced turnkey solutions to any inspection problem you might have.
JLI Vision A/S was founded in 1985, and is one of the oldest dedicated vision companies in the world. With more than 39 years of industry experience, 400+ years of compiled experience and 1800+ systems shipped worldwide and counting, we make custom designed & advanced turnkey solutions to any inspection problem you might have. We have experience working with inspection of glass cartridges, with defects down to the tens of micrometers in size, to large-scale steel and other metal surface inspection, microchip inspection, plastics, wood and much more. We offer independent consulting to tailor the inspection solution to your needs and desires, and are working with you throughout the entire process. We are generally known for finding solutions to "impossible" inspection problems. 
Our solutions in the past have involved 2D and 3D inspection, Hybrid-vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, general Computer Vision approaches and much more. We are a well-known System Integrator for some of the largest Danish companies, as well as for many companies worldwide. We are capable of either delivering end-to-end systems that takes care of the entire inspection process for you, or integrating and installing our systems seamlessly into existing machinery and systems on-site. Following installation of our solutions, we can take care of the system maintenance, patching and optimizing for you to ensure the solution remains viable and competitive years down the line. We have extensive experience working in demanding industries with very low margins of error, such as the medical industry. Here we have complied successfully with the many additional and extensive requirements for vision systems in this industry, such as audit-trailing, GAMP-5 category 5, URS, FAT, SAT and many others. We meet the very high requirements of vision systems that are also present in the aerospace and space industry.
For information on how we approach vision solutions with very high demands and thorough documentation standards, please refer to the following hyperlinks to two videos from our vision lab: Why machine vision for medical is difficult and how we solve the challenge, Creating a validated machine learning solution for Pharma.

Our services are available to you no matter where you might be in the world, and we have installed and serviced systems in countries like Brazil, China, Japan, The United States, Malaysia, most European countries and more. Our team consists of 40+ highly competent engineers from various engineering and scientific backgrounds, ensuring a broad technical profile to solve any task, utilizing the latest and best technology on the market. We are good at thinking outside of the box, and combining approaches and techniques from different fields to find new and innovate approaches to any problem. We also dedicate a large sum of money for our R&D department to ensure we follow along with the latest research trends and don't stagnate or fall behind due to more "conservative" approaches. We see ourselves as enemies of the "that's the way it's always been done"-type of mindset. 
For further insight into how we approach various inspection problems, please use the following hyperlink to view our Vision Lab video series on our website: JLI Vision's Vision Lab video series.

entityDescription: Igence Radar Ltd was founded in 1995 to develop and exploit models of all aspects of radar operation and performance. The team has many years of experience of radar research and technology leading to an understanding of the scientific principles of EM scattering, radar signal & clutter fluctuations and processing, which underpin the operation of modern radar systems. Radar signal processing algorithms and concepts, developed for the detection of small targets in clutter, have been widely implemented in both experimental and operational radars. We have also considerable experience of tracking including the development and implementation of novel tracking algorithms and the production of mathematical models characterising their performance. We have a solid track record of rapidly prototyping radar software applications to analyse trials data to assess radar performance and to de-risk upgrades to radar signal processing. This capability is built on our Virtual Radar Library (ViRad), which is a library of tried and tested C++ classes for radar simulation, signal processing and performance modelling. It allows us to construct a wide range of reliable, bespoke, radar applications in a timely and cost effective manner. In addition to our work on radar our areas of expertise include: Radar Signal processing (including Maritime Surveillance, Synthetic Aperture, Pulsed-Doppler); Radar project support; Radar modelling, performance prediction and simulation; Bayesian techniques including Bayes Nets and Tracking algorithms; Mathematical modelling; Image exploitation, classification and automatic target recognition; Synthetic Aperture Radar image formation, motion compensation and autofocus; Electromagnetic Scattering e.g. propagation modelling, integral equation description of low grazing angle scattering of microwaves; Change detection (coherent and incoherent SAR change detection, optical change detection); Rapid prototyping of software applications.

entityDescription:
Prometheus Sensing Ltd
 
Wildfires can cause significant damage to ecosystems, the environment and communities and cost billions of dollars every year around the world - including the UK. While some ecosystems have evolved to require occasional burning, wildfires are increasing in frequency, severity and range. This increase is due to a number of factors including global warming and human activity. It is reported that between 65% and 90% of wildfires have an anthropogenic cause.
Satellite-borne infra-red cameras have been used for a number of years to detect wildfires although the spatial and temporal resolution has been a limiting factor. Recent advances in the resolution of these systems provides an opportunity to detect wildfires much earlier in their life when they are small and manageable. Prometheus Sensing Ltd are developing a system that uses these high resolution images to not only detect wildfires but to provide the following services.
- Extract fire characteristics from the images such as growth rate, fire-line intensity, spot fire density, etc.

- Provide pseudo real-time information to command and frontline firefighters.

- Deploy Uncrewed Air Vehicles (UAV) autonomously to tackle early-life wildfires and to support conventional firefighters with larger fires.

Prometheus Sensing's mission is to reduce the environmental, societal and financial costs of wildfires as well as reducing the risk of harm to firefighters through timely and effective interventions.
